Lore

[edit | edit source]

Chiron, the Great Teacher, stands apart from his kin as a centaur of wisdom rather than savagery. Scholar, poet, and master of the stars, he devoted his long life to shaping heroes, training legends such as Achilles, Perseus, and Ajax not only in combat, but in discipline and restraint. Yet time and again, the world has chosen to sing of war over knowledge, forcing Chiron to set aside his scrolls for bow and armor. Now, as chaos threatens all he cherishes, the mentor steps onto the battlefield himself. Those who choose Chiron value precision, foresight, and mastery, striking from range with calculated power while guiding the fight with the calm of a true teacher.

Abilities

[edit | edit source]
Basic Attack - Chiron Basic Attack Notes:
  • Projectile stops on first target hit, and does not pass through walls
Fire a projectile that deals Physical Damage to the first enemy hit
  • Damage Scaling: 100% Strength + 20% Intelligence + 100% Attack Damage
  • Range: 8.8 meters
  • Radius: 0.48 meters
Ability Video


Passive - Herbal Medicine | Heal and Empower Allies Notes:
  • Healed allies also gain Strength and Intelligence for a duration
  • Heal applies 5 times over 5 seconds
  • Poultices prioritize the allied god with the lowest Health in range
  • If no injured allied gods are nearby, a charge will not be consumed
Gain a charge every 12 seconds. Using an ability consumes a charge to throw a poultice to an injured allied god, applying a Heal over time
  • Heal: 20 + 4 Per Level
  • Strength: 5 + 1 Per Level
  • Intelligence: 10 + 1.5 Per Level
  • Buff Duration: 5 seconds
Ability Video


1st Ability - Training Exercise | Area Damage and Cleanse
Deploy a constellation that grants CC Immunity to allies in the area. After a 1 second delay, it explodes dealing Physical Damage to all enemies in the area
  • Damage: 100 | 150 | 200 | 250 | 300
  • Damage Scaling: 80% Strength
  • CC Immunity Duration: 0.5 seconds
  • Range: 8.8 meters
  • Radius: 2.8 meters
  • Cooldown: 13 seconds
  • Cost: 55 | 60 | 65 | 70 | 75 mana
Ability Video


2nd Ability - Masterful Shot | Mark and Fire Arrows Notes:
  • If you have at least 250 Strength, after hitting an enemy god with Mastery Shot, you can fire a second larger arrow in a targeted area, dealing Physical Damage, plus bonus damage per god initially hit, up to 4 targets (Note: Despite the tooltip, hitting more than 4 targets continues scaling the damage)
  • If you have at least 2.5 Attack Speed, Masterful Shot becomes Masterful Flurry, quickly firing 3 arrows with reduced scaling at each Marked enemy god. Each arrow procs Attack Item Effects and increases Chiron's Attack Damage
  • Both ability modifiers can be active at once
  • This ability cannot be activated unless an enemy has a mark
Apply Target Mark when you damage enemies with your Attacks or abilities, reducing their Physical Protections. Activating this ability fires seeking arrows toward all marked targets, dealing Physical Damage and Slowing them
  • Damage: 55 | 100 | 145 | 195 | 240
  • Damage Scaling: 70% Strength
  • Refire Damage: 55 | 100 | 145 | 195 | 240
  • Refire Damage Scaling: 70% Strength + 15% Per Masterful Shot Target Hit
  • Flurry Damage: 27.5% Strength + 45% Attack Damage
  • Physical Protection Reduction: 10%
  • Debuff Duration: 3.5 seconds
  • Slow: 25 | 27.5 | 30 | 32.5 | 35%
  • Slow Duration: 2 seconds
  • Attack Damage Buff: 8 | 11 | 14 | 17 | 20
  • Max Buff Stacks: 5
  • Buff Duration: 5 seconds
  • Cooldown: 15 seconds
  • Cost: 65 mana
Ability Video


3rd Ability - Giddyup! | Charge Forward Knockback Notes:
  • You are displacement Immune while Dashing
  • You gain Strength for the duration of the Dash
  • You can fire Attacks and Masterful Shot while Dashing
Dash forward, dealing Physical Damage to enemies, Knocking Up non-god enemies, and Knocking Back enemy gods
  • Damage: 75 | 105 | 135 | 165 | 195
  • Damage Scaling: 50% Strength
  • Strength: 10 | 20 | 30 | 40 | 50
  • Cooldown: 16 seconds
  • Cost: 70 mana
Ability Video


Ultimate - Centaurus | Long Range Arrows Notes:
  • If you would be killed while channeling this ability, you do not die until you run out of time or shots
  • If you would have died but killed an enemy with this ability, you are Healed for health equal to the damage dealt instead
  • You can fire Masterful Shot while channeling this ability
  • This ability passes through and damages all enemies, and passes through walls
Transform into a constellation, reducing Movement Speed, but gaining the ability to fire three long distance arrows, dealing Physical Damage to all enemies hit
  • Damage: 130 | 175 | 220 | 265 | 310
  • Damage Scaling: 65% Strength
  • Self Slow: 40%
  • Range: 19.2 meters
  • Cooldown: 90 seconds
  • Cost: 55 | 60 | 65 | 70 | 75 mana
Ability Video


God Aspect

[edit | edit source]
Aspect of the Heroic Tutor
Target Mark now only applies to one target, and you passively copy 10% of damage done to that target, dealing it again as Physical Damage. Target Mark can no longer apply to lane minions. Training Exercise boosts Allies' Strength and Intelligence when it hits or cleanses them. Centaurus has less scaling, but slows enemies, and when it hits allies, grants them Attack Speed, Shield and applies Herbal Medicine's buff.
Aspect Enhanced Abilities (Click to Expand)
1st Ability - Training Exercise | Area Damage and Cleanse Notes:
  • Any allies standing in the area when the CC Immunity is applied or when it explodes gain Strength and Intelligence
Deploy a constellation that grants CC Immune to allies in the area. After a 1 second delay, it explodes dealing Physical Damage to all enemies in the area
  • Damage: 100 | 150 | 200 | 250 | 300
  • Damage Scaling: 80% Strength
  • CC Immunity Duration: 0.5 seconds
  • Strength: 10 | 18 | 26 | 34 | 42
  • Intelligence: 10 | 20 | 30 | 40 | 50
  • Range: 8.8 meters
  • Radius: 2.8 meters
  • Cooldown: 13 seconds
  • Cost: 55 | 60 | 65 | 70 | 75 mana
Ability Video


2nd Ability - Masterful Shot | Mark and Fire Arrows Notes:
  • Activating this ability fires an arrow toward your target, dealing Physical Damage and Slowing them.
  • When the arrow hits a target, the mark will be enhanced on that target. If the target is hit 5 times, they become Stunned
Apply Target Mark when you damage an enemy with your Attacks or abilities, reducing their Physical Protections. You can only mark one target at a time. When any damage is done to your marked target, you replicate 10% of that damage as Physical Damage and gain a Masterful Shot Stack
  • Damage: 55 | 100 | 145 | 195 | 240
  • Bonus Damage: 3 | 6 | 9 | 12 | 15 Per Stack
  • Physical Protection Reduction: 10%
  • Debuff Duration: 3.5 seconds
  • Slow: 25 | 27.5 | 30 | 32.5 | 35%
  • Slow Duration: 2 seconds
  • Stun Duration: 1 | 1.1 | 1.2 | 1.3 | 1.4 seconds
  • Cooldown: 15 seconds
  • Cost: 65 mana
Ability Video


Ultimate - Centaurus | Long Range Arrows Notes:
  • If you would be killed while channeling this ability, you do not die until you run out of time or shots
  • If you would have died but killed an enemy with this ability, you are Healed for health equal to the damage dealt instead
  • You can fire Masterful Shot while channeling this ability
  • This ability passes through and damages all enemies, and passes through walls
Transform into a constellation, reducing Movement Speed, but gaining the ability to fire three long distance arrows, dealing Physical Damage to and Slowing all enemies they hit, as well as applying a Shield, Attack Speed, and your passive Healing to all allies they hit
  • Damage: 130 | 175 | 220 | 265 | 310
  • Damage Scaling: 65% Strength
  • Shield Health: 50 | 100 | 150 | 200 | 250
  • Attack Speed: 15 | 20 | 25 | 30 | 35%
  • Buff Duration: 3 seconds
  • Self Slow: 40%
  • Range: 19.2 meters
  • Cooldown: 90 seconds
  • Cost: 55 | 60 | 65 | 70 | 75 mana

  • Herbal Medicine
  • Decreased Strength: 10 -> 5
  • Decreased Intelligence: 15 + 2 per level -> 10 + 1.5 per level
  • Masterful Shot
  • Increased Cooldown: 15s -> 17/16.5/16/15.5/15s

SMITE 2 Open Beta 28 (February 10, 2026)

  • Masterful Shot
  • Decreased Scaling: 80% -> 70%

SMITE 2 Open Beta 27 (January 27, 2026)

  • General
  • Chiron has been added to the game.
